summary: First testing iteration. Executed 26 backend pytest cases (100% pass) covering /api/health, /api/data (all 15 expected keys + no _id leakage), /api/data/{name} 404 for unknown, /api/catalog (93 materials), /api/tracking/{token} (400/404/200), /api/clinics/{id}/contact (200/404). Frontend verified via Playwright on the public preview URL: sign-in persona cards, role-based sidebar nav & page titles for OWNER001/MGR0001/DT001/DT003/DT004/DT005, URL guards (DT001 -> /logistics or /reports redirects to /dashboard), direct access to protected URL without persona redirects to /, tooth-order dialog + Add + Send to Manager demo toast + 'No teeth selected' error, materials catalog shows 93 products, driver portal for D0001 (Route updated banner, PLACE NEW STOP, Tallaght current stop, Full Route, Start Break), driver D0003 'No mission scheduled', public /track for completed/arrived/pending/invalid/unknown tokens including live map iframe for arrived stop. Mobile 390px: tracking, driver, dashboard, logistics and materials pages have NO horizontal overflow. No React/JS console errors on any main page (one benign 404 on a static asset).

issues: One 404 console error observed on tracking page load (looks like favicon/apple-touch-icon or similar). Not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Resolve the single 404 asset request observed on /track pages to keep console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend code is cleanly structured: core/, routers/, seed/ separation is clear; BaseDocument.to_api() centralises _id removal (no ObjectId leakage detected in any endpoint).
Tracking endpoint correctly validates 48-hex token format with regex and returns 400 vs 404 for malformed vs unknown — matches spec exactly.
Catalog is cached via lru_cache on JSON load — good for read-only reference data.
No DB write endpoints exist — matches the read-only demo contract; all mutating UI actions go through demoSave toast as expected.
test_credentials: No passwords. Persona picker on / via data-testid signin-staff-<id lowercase> or signin-driver-<id lowercase>; persona stored in localStorage key 'dt-demo-persona'.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend serves relative-to-today seed data; today = 2026-10-05 (Mon). Today's routes R20261005-022 (D0001 started) and R20261005-023 (D0002 published) present as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green with 26 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (pytest.ini has xdist, 2 workers). Tooth buttons are rendered via data-testid pattern 'tooth-<group>-<id>' (e.g. tooth-upper-anteriors-s1); the group container also has data-testid 'tooth-group-<group>' so filter by exact pattern. Native <select> options use the label attribute. Valid tracking tokens for today can be fetched from /api/data/routes -> trackingTokens map. Full feature-parity exploration (holidays validations, logistics route dialog add-stop, driver planning flow for D0002 end-to-end, PDF/print) was NOT exhaustively driven but the pages all load without console errors and the write actions that were triggered correctly produced the 'Demo mode' sonner toast.
